  Affected items: ASSUMPTION-474, ASSUMPTION-476, ASSUMPTION-481, PRESUMPTION-500, PRESUMPTION-502, PRESUMPTION-503, PRESUMPTION-505
  Common vulnerability: REMEDY-INHERITS-DEFECT. In seven of fourteen items the observation is sound and the proposed remedy reproduces, at one level up, the exact property the observation was about. A-476 answers a detector whose reference is generated by the monitored process with a second reference (wall clock) that is non-monotonic and drifts, and fires it into a channel with no consumer. P-500/A-475 answer "we are measuring agreement instead of understanding" with an instrument (the ideological Turing test) whose passing criterion is opponents' agreement. P-502 answers "flagging is presumed to be delivery" with acknowledgement receipts, under which "acknowledged" is presumed to be "acted on." P-503 answers "the summarizer's claims exceed its evidence" with a coverage percentage that rises when more marginal artifacts are read and reads green during the failure it was built to catch. P-505 answers "detectors invert" with a discrepancy check that is provably blind to common-mode inversion, in a fleet whose monitors share runtime, scheduler and permissions with their subjects. A-481 answers "our number may be wrong" with silence, which the evidence says leaves the consumer holding the same wrong number uncaveated. A-474 answers "this proxy measures the wrong thing" with a different proxy subject to the identical Goodhart argument, and one that agents can write to directly. This is distinct from the 2026-07-19 flag (remedy-jumping before a discriminating test): here the discriminating test is not merely skipped, the remedy is structurally isomorphic to the disease, so running the remedy would produce a green signal over the unfixed condition — converting a visible defect into an invisible one.
  Literature basis: Brand et al., "The Ideological Turing Test," Cognitive Science 2025, doi 10.1111/cogs.70126 (passing operationalised as opponents' agreement); "Degradation Detection in a Redundant Sensor Architecture," PMC9228164 (same-characteristic faults in both channels undetectable by discrepancy analysis); Redis distributed-locks documentation (TTL expiry not monotonic-clock based; wall-clock shift breaks the invariant); AHRQ Making Healthcare Safer IV, PMC12232517 (low-certainty evidence for SBAR; effect conditioned on a synchronous live receiver); futureagi.com, "LLM Eval Monitoring Dashboards" (aggregate rollups healthy while a route sits at the floor; remedy is per-slice binding, not coverage); van der Bles et al., PNAS 2020, PMID 32205438 (unquantified verbal uncertainty lowers trust; recipients resolve ambiguity toward priors); Splunk and Psych Safety on Goodhart's law (remedy is a panel of measures, not proxy substitution).
  Risk level: High
  Recommendation: Before any remedy in this batch is built, apply a single test to it: state the property the observation identified as defective, then ask whether the proposed instrument has that same property. If it does, the remedy will produce a green signal over the unfixed condition and is worse than no remedy, because the current defects are at least visible. Concretely: measure whether a mutual-registration score correlates with agreement before adopting it; instrument flags for content-appearing-in-recipient-output rather than acknowledgement; count claims-without-evidence rather than coverage; run a live proof-test rather than a reachability audit; verify the scheduled context's clock before keying anything to it; report a numeric floor rather than abstaining. Each of these is cheaper than the remedy it replaces.

  Secondary pattern (recorded, not flagged): SAME-DAY GENERALIZATION. Four items in this batch (A-479's 7-of-12, A-480, P-504's three breaches, P-505's four detectors) generalize from cases observed and counted on a single day by the pipeline that also produced them, with no external coding rule and no base rate. This is the posture challenged in PRESUMPTION-499 on 2026-07-19 and it has not narrowed. In every instance the base rate is obtainable cheaply from the existing record; none was obtained.

CROSS-ITEM-EVALUATION-1: 15a's CROSS-ITEM-NOTE (2026-07-20) — the shared-substrate confound
  Flag as raised: ASSUMPTION-477 and PRESUMPTION-500 turn on one condition from opposite directions. C2A2's agents are drawn from a common pretrained model, so apparent independence (A-477) and apparent mutual understanding (P-500) may both be artefacts of shared pretraining rather than of the architecture. 15a recommends 15c treat it as a single cross-cutting concern rather than two item-local caveats.
  15c evaluation: **UPHELD, and it is the strongest cross-item finding of the run.** The confound is one mechanism with two failure surfaces, and in both cases it defeats an instrument the system is about to trust. For A-477: structural file-access blocking removes the READ channel and does not touch shared-pretraining correlation, which the retrieved 2025-2026 multi-agent literature identifies as the dominant channel — so the 07-19 change did not deliver independence, and saying it did installs a false green over the pipeline's own epistemics. For P-500: an agent may produce a rival tradition's arguments fluently from shared pretraining rather than from registration acquired in dialogue, so an ITT-style instrument would read HIGH AT BASELINE and be insensitive to exactly what it was adopted to measure. Both require the same mitigation, which is a PRE-CONDITION BASELINE, and neither was addressed by the remedies attached to the items.
  15c action taken: (a) A-477 dispositioned REVISE-233, whose recommended action 4 is the measurement that would size the dominant channel — run 15a and 15b on one item under full blocking and measure source-citation overlap. Never taken. (b) P-500 dispositioned REVISE-235, whose recommended action 6 makes a pre-dialogue ITT baseline MANDATORY before any post-dialogue score is interpretable. (c) The confound is recorded in MONITOR-453's transfer note so it cannot be lost if REVISE-235 stalls awaiting review. It is NOT left as two item-local caveats.
  Second half of the same note: 15a records A-474, A-480, P-501 and P-503 as partly non-independent readings of the same two 2026-07-19 events, and warns 15c not to read four supported items as four independent confirmations.
  15c evaluation: **UPHELD and acted on structurally, not just noted.** Of the four, only two entered the register, and each on a literature independent of the events and of each other: PREMISE-105 (A-474) on official-statistics break-and-backcast practice, PREMISE-109 (P-503) on monitoring-stack architecture. Of the other two, A-480 was dispositioned MONITOR-455 as PREMISE-109's EVIDENCING INSTANCE rather than as a coequal claim — which is also 15b's own recommendation — so one defect receives one premise and one remediation effort; and P-501 was dispositioned MONITOR-456 and NOT incorporated, on a separate ground (conflict with PREMISE-101, below). The independence caveat is written into PREMISE-105 and PREMISE-109 themselves so any future reader inherits it. Net: four non-independent items produced two premises resting on two disjoint literatures, not four confirmations.

CROSS-ITEM-EVALUATION-2: 15b's SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG (High, 2026-07-20) — "REMEDY-INHERITS-DEFECT"
  Flag as raised: in 7 of 14 items (A-474, A-476, A-481, P-500, P-502, P-503, P-505) the observation is sound but the proposed remedy is structurally isomorphic to the disease, so running it would produce a green signal over an unfixed condition.

In summary: every named instrument was EXCLUDED from what was incorporated, and in the four cases that produced a premise the non-isomorphic instrument was made LOAD-BEARING inside the premise text — PREMISE-108 binds delivery to content-appearing-in-recipient-output and forbids acknowledgement as a health metric; PREMISE-109 binds to claims-without-evidence and excludes coverage percentage; PREMISE-110 folds in the common-mode scope guard and replaces the reachability audit with a live proof-test; PREMISE-105 excludes connectivity as the replacement metric. **No defective instrument entered the validated-premises register this run.**

A-477 announces that 15a/15b independence "became structural" when the enforced channel is the weakest of at least four and the dominant one is untouched — a green signal over an unfixed condition, raised by the same pipeline that raised the flag, on the same day. ## CONSISTENCY CHECK AGAINST validated_premises.md (required before any INCORPORATE)
---

  One conflict found, surfaced rather than silently resolved:
  **PRESUMPTION-501 vs PREMISE-101.** P-501's directional recommendation — treat a count disagreement as a contradiction to reconcile rather than a measurement problem to de-inflate — would conflict with PREMISE-101 (2026-07-19), which holds that counts are properties of a reading (a scope/method/time tuple) and that "independent agents will produce divergent counts of the same object WITHOUT EITHER BEING WRONG."
  Decision: **PREMISE-101 is retained; P-501 is NOT incorporated.** Stated reason: this is not a preference between two equal claims. PREMISE-101 was validated on 15a SUPPORTED/Strong plus 15b PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED/Moderate. P-501 arrives with weaker support (SUPPORTED/Moderate-Strong) and a stronger challenge (CHALLENGED/Moderate), and — decisively — the literature 15b retrieved AGAINST P-501 is the same data-reconciliation literature that GROUNDS PREMISE-101. The newer item is less well supported precisely on the point where the two diverge. P-501 goes to MONITOR-456 with the frozen-snapshot test that would settle it, and the conflict is written into that entry.
  Three consistency EXTENSIONS found, no conflict: PREMISE-106 extends the existing 15d-refresh-queue instability premise to the lit-search queue (both hold arrival exceeds service and both name arrival AND service as decision variables); PREMISE-108 is the agent-to-agent generalisation of PREMISE-102 (fail-loud is reporting, not remediation), entered one confidence grade lower; PREMISE-110 generalises PREMISE-100 (a liveness signal is not evidence of correctness), and PREMISE-100 remains ACTIVE as the specific case. PREMISE-109 is complementary to PREMISE-100, not overlapping.

  NOTE ON THE 482/513 PAIR — handled explicitly, not collapsed. The searches were run jointly. On retrieved evidence Theory of Constraints favours 513 over 482: the framework 482 invokes holds that knowledge-work constraints are usually policy constraints and that these are the most frequently misidentified, and the 15-day unexecuted record is direct evidence for 513 that 482 does not explain. Both are marked PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED for different reasons: 482 for asserting an information constraint without separating detection from response, 513 for imposing an exclusive disjunction and overstating its falsifier. One cheap experiment settles both: execute one measurement and observe whether a disposition changes within seven days. Not executed favours 513; executed with a disposition change favours 482; executed with no disposition change falsifies both and indicates a third constraint — most plausibly the missing CAPA effectiveness check.

Measure 15a/15b source-citation overlap under full blocking, and for every claimed second check record the four shared components (code path, corpus, model, execution context). Adopt NASEM vocabulary vault-wide and forbid "independently confirmed" unless the second check obtained its own data by a different path. Treat checks sharing all four components as single-channel regardless of how they are labelled.

SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG-B:
  Date: 2026-07-21
  Affected items: ASSUMPTION-486, ASSUMPTION-489, PRESUMPTION-507, PRESUMPTION-510
  Common vulnerability: Sound observation, over-corrective remedy. Each of these four items pairs a defensible finding with a proposed control whose own documented failure mode is worse than the problem — abolishing acknowledgement (removes the fastest failure detector and cannot distinguish non-receipt from informed rejection), tightening a detector without an oracle (converts false positives into silent false negatives), quarantining disputed figures (stops work in a channel that cannot clear the stop), a flat admission cap (binds immediately, gets raised, leaves λ−μ untouched). In every case the literature's actual remedy is graded rather than binary.
  Literature basis: Joint Commission Journal on Quality and Safety, S1549-3741(04)30053-5 and PMC12597367 (read-back increases task completion). Snyk / OX Security on threshold loosening suppressing detection. ONS Revisions and Correction of Errors Policy (mark and revise, not withdraw). arXiv:2603.13870 and arXiv:2601.22295 (value-based screening and dynamic shadow price over fixed caps); practitioner evidence that fixed WIP limits are raised on first bind.
  Risk level: High
  Recommendation: Apply a standing rule at disposition time — before adopting any proposed control, search for its documented failure mode and state it. Prefer graded controls (discount, flag, value-based triage, read-back with content) to binary ones (abolish, quarantine, cap). Require every proposed detector or process change to come with a positive control demonstrating it still fires when it should.

SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG-C:
  Date: 2026-07-21
  Affected items: ASSUMPTION-482, ASSUMPTION-490, PRESUMPTION-506, PRESUMPTION-512, PRESUMPTION-513
  Common vulnerability: Findings are generated and closed without an effectiveness check, and success bars are implicit rather than pre-registered. 482 and 513 dispute which constraint binds with no pre-registered threshold; 490 asks which reading is authoritative with no written definition; 506 infers total propagation failure with no prior for what success looks like; 512 asks for an hours total with no target. The CAPA literature identifies exactly this — investigation completed, effectiveness criterion never defined, failure recurs, record documents the cycle — as the most common failure of correction programmes, and it is visible in ASSUMPTION-488's recurrence.
  Literature basis: CAPA practice literature (Deltek, "The CAPA Process"; The FDA Group, "Definitive Guide to CAPA"; SimplerQMS) — effectiveness criteria must be defined at the start and met before closure; most CAPA failures occur at follow-up, not investigation. Ivers et al., Cochrane CD000259.pub3 (PMID 22696318) and .pub4 — the realistic effect size of feedback is 4–6% absolute, which is the prior any propagation mechanism should be judged against. ISO/IEC 17025 clauses 7.10/8.7 (verify the fix worked).
  Risk level: Critical
  Recommendation: Add a mandatory field to every validated premise, disposition and revision flag: what evidence would show this changed behaviour, by when, and who checks. No item closes until that evidence exists. Pre-register success thresholds before running any of the five measurements, so results are interpretable rather than arguable after the fact. This single change addresses the mechanism behind 488's recurrence, 506's propagation gap and the 482/513 dispute simultaneously, and it is the highest-leverage recommendation in this batch.

The item argues that errors observed IN a point-in-time backup rule OUT a mid-write artifact. SQLite's own corruption documentation lists backing up a database while it is being written as a canonical cause of "database disk image is malformed," which makes the observation evidence FOR the artifact hypothesis, not against it. 15a independently reached the same conclusion from the supportive side: the exclusion holds only if the copy went through the backup API or VACUUM INTO with proper locking, and an ordinary filesystem copy of a live database is a known source of spurious malformed-image errors. 15b adds that the two halves of the claim are mutually dependent — a stopped writer would not produce mid-write artifacts — so the item cannot be half-right in the way it is written.
  Disposition: **REVISE -> REVISE-238 (Urgency HIGH)**
  Reasoning: Urgency is HIGH on the REMEDY, not the diagnosis. Both searchers independently retrieved the same warning: on an already-corrupt file VACUUM will either fail with another SQLITE_CORRUPT or **silently drop the unreadable data**, converting detected corruption into undetected data loss; and `.recover` can resurrect previously deleted rows as live data with no marker. Running the item's proposed VACUUM INTO rebuild on the strength of this diagnosis risks silent, unmarked data loss or silent, unmarked data ADDITION into open-story — in a vault already carrying six unresolved counting disputes, where either outcome would be indistinguishable from the disputes already open. This is the single action in the batch with an irreversible failure mode, which is exactly PREMISE-107's binding case for diagnose-before-repair.
  What is at risk: open-story.db integrity and every count derived from it; the "writer has stopped" diagnosis, which if wrong (writer running and failing at commit) leaves the real fault in place behind a completed repair.
  Recommended action: Run `PRAGMA integrity_check` on the LIVE database Mac-side before any recovery action — minutes of work, and it discriminates cleanly. Establish how the point-in-time backup was taken (backup API / VACUUM INTO / filesystem copy) before treating the backup's errors as evidence about the live file. Do NOT run VACUUM or VACUUM INTO on the corrupt copy. If recovery is needed, prefer `.recover` with row-count reconciliation against a known-good prior snapshot, and mark any resurrected rows. Separately confirm whether the writer process is stopped or running-and-failing.

  **Standing observations this run makes about itself, per the fail-loud convention:**

  1. **The independence defect is now measured, and it is in this run.** 15a and 15b were run under full blocking as separate agents that could not read each other's output, and they still retrieved the SAME key sources on at least five items (A-483, A-490/P-507, P-506, P-511, P-512). That is a direct in-run observation of SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG-A and of the very correlation ASSUMPTION-483 is about. It means the agreement between the two directions on those items is worth materially less than two independent confirmations, and every disposition above that leans on "both agents converged" should be read with that discount. This is the first quantitative datum the vault has on its own 15a/15b correlation; it was produced as a by-product rather than by the measurement REVISE-240 requests, and it does not substitute for it.

  2. **PREMISE-118, incorporated in this run, is violated by this run.** It holds that naming a defect in an instrument obliges a retrospective impact assessment of results already produced by it. The defect is named (LLM reconciler over two LLM searches from a common pretrained model; 8–22pp accuracy shortfall in the panel literature), it was named yesterday in REVISE-233, and no retrospective assessment of the 2026-07-20 dispositions or of the 110 standing premises has been performed. The 18 dispositions above were produced anyway. Per PREMISE-118 the correct response is neither to disown them nor to proceed silently, but to price the defect and assess retrospectively — recorded in REVISE-240 and unremedied at the time of writing. **This is the second consecutive run in which this agent has documented the same unremedied condition, which is itself the pattern ASSUMPTION-488 and PRESUMPTION-506 describe.**

The count is an output, not an achievement, and MONITOR-461 exists to test whether this pipeline can tell a bad day from a good one at all.

  4. **Sixteen of the eighteen dispositions turn on a measurement that has not been taken**, and across the cohort they reduce to roughly seven distinct actions, six of which cost under an hour: `PRAGMA integrity_check` on the live open-story.db (the only one with an irreversible failure mode if skipped, REVISE-238); sum the open ask awaiting Tom in hours (one query, named by both searchers as the most useful artifact in the batch); enumerate 30 days of cross-agent flags into three bins including received-and-declined; measure 15a/15b source-citation overlap under full blocking; classify 30 days against a pre-registered bad-day definition; execute one cheap measurement and watch seven days for a disposition change; write the counting definition and re-derive over a frozen snapshot. **This is the sixteenth consecutive day on which this pipeline has produced a list of cheap unexecuted measurements, which is the evidence PRESUMPTION-513 rests on and which this run has now added to rather than reduced.** The five items entering MONITOR join a queue whose consumption has been near zero for nineteen days (BACKLOG-FLAG, 8th consecutive surfacing), and per PREMISE-116 — incorporated above — routing them is not evidence they will be re-evaluated.

  5. **Two items in this batch are testable from the vault itself and were not tested by this agent**, which had the tools to do so: ASSUMPTION-487's integrity check and PRESUMPTION-512's hours total. 15c's spec does not authorise it to run either, and 15c did not exceed its spec. Recording the boundary rather than the excuse: the pipeline's design places the cheapest decisive measurements outside the authority of every agent that identifies them, which is a structural statement of SYSTEMIC-RISK-C and is the substance of REVISE-239.

ISO/IEC 27001:2022 cl.6.1.3(d) (a self-scoped denominator with documented, justified exclusions is the standard's own REQUIRED OUTPUT FORMAT; the audit checks that inclusions and exclusions correspond to the risk assessment, NOT that the denominator is maximal); NIST SP 800-53B (2020) (tailoring is a first-class operation: controls tailored out require a recorded risk-based rationale approved by responsible officials — the audited property is ACCOUNTING-FOR, not covering); IAASB ISA 200 and ISA 320 (assurance is REASONABLE, not absolute, and scoping the population down by materiality is the mandated method, not a compromise of it); Spring et al. 2019/2021, SEI SSVC (in a triage decision tree "defer" is a TERMINAL NODE reached by assessing exploitation, exposure, utility and mission impact — the output is the product of the analysis, not a substitute for it); ISO/IEC 27005 (risk RETENTION is one of four named treatments — "no action taken" against pre-defined acceptance criteria is a treatment decision, not an absence of one). What survives and sharpens: every one of these frameworks demands the same thing, which is not a maximal denominator but a recorded, checkable, per-item rationale, a named approver, and testing by someone other than the classifier. 15b concedes the local clause outright: "the presumption's second clause — that today's finding was that the roster reader could not read the page — is a specific, local, and undefeated objection, and nothing located addresses it ... a figure derived from an unreadable page is being reported with the confidence of a figure derived from a read one." Boundary source: Kuperman, Tobin & Kraschnewski 2014, J Grad Med Educ 6(4):675-679 — self-reported compliance 82% vs 68% on external audit of the same population, a persistent ~14-point positive bias. NOTE (15c): 15b ALSO relied on ISO/IEC 27001 cl.6.1.3(d) without reading the standard directly ("much of the readily available material ... is vendor guidance rather than the standard text"). BOTH DIRECTIONS therefore rest a load-bearing and mutually opposed reading on the same paywalled clause, verified only by secondary description — a correlated verification gap, and a live instance of PREMISE-132 and PREMISE-120.

### 15b SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAGs raised this run (three), and one 15b cross-item note
FLAG (i) 2026-07-29, "categorical-parity / binary-not-graded", over PRESUMPTION-566 + PRESUMPTION-567. Risk level: High. Both items run the inference "the instrument or procedure that produced X belongs to the same kind as one already known to be fallible, therefore X inherits that fallibility undiminished," and so treat a GRADED epistemic property as binary — warrant-from-iterated-generalisation in 566, independence-in-verification in 567. The relevant literatures hold that the categorical similarity is not decisive and that the correct move is to SIZE the residual: state the population and termination criterion (Mitchell 1982; Mayo 2018), or estimate the dependence parameter (beta factors; diversity gain; threats-and-safeguards). Left unchecked the pattern generates a regress in which NO CORRECTION CAN BE BANKED AND NO CHECKER CAN BE TRUSTED, because every candidate belongs to some already-impugned kind. Literature basis: Norton 2003; Mitchell 1982; Mayo 2018; Hajek 2007; Littlewood & Miller 1989, IEEE TSE 15(12); NUREG/CR-5485 (Mosleh et al. 1998); Agrawal et al. 2024, Findings of EACL. Recommendation: where 14b surfaces a same-kind-therefore-same-status presumption, require the follow-up to NAME THE QUANTITY that would settle it (a stopping criterion, a dependence estimate, a miss rate) rather than resting on the categorical parity.
FLAG (ii) 2026-07-29, "favourable-direction without a null model", over PRESUMPTION-568 + PRESUMPTION-569 (and cf. PRESUMPTION-565, structurally INVERTED — it argued from NON-uniform direction). Risk level: High. Both items infer a motivated-reasoning explanation from a direction-of-favourability pattern — six defects all classified in the direction that preserves the disposition (568); a rate moving in the direction that vindicates a self-imposed bar (569) — without establishing a null model or a base rate for how often that pattern arises from a legitimate single mechanism or from ordinary variation. The pattern-of-favourability heuristic is real and IS codified (ISA 450's qualitative bias indicator) but it is a PROMPT TO INVESTIGATE, not a finding, and it requires a denominator before it carries weight. Literature basis: ISA 450; Spiegelhalter 2005, Statistics in Medicine 24(8); Levitt & List 2011, AEJ: Applied 3(1); McCambridge et al. 2014, J Clin Epidemiol 67(3). Recommendation: before a 14b presumption rests on a favourable-direction pattern, require (i) a stated null model with a denominator and (ii) an explicit check for a single legitimate mechanism that would produce the whole pattern; absent both, file the observation as a prompt to investigate rather than as an inferred presumption. 15b adds the reflexive warning: without this the presumption stream systematically converts ordinary variation and normal criterion effects into imputations of motivated reasoning, which is itself a directional bias — and one the pipeline has no independent check against, since it is the same pipeline being assessed.
FLAG (iii) 2026-07-29, "gate-vs-grade", over PRESUMPTION-570 + PRESUMPTION-572. Risk level: High. Both convert a graded, revisable practice into a BINARY PRECONDITION that must be satisfied before an inference is permitted — provisional causal attribution corrected by re-triage (570), graded analogical alignment revised by negative-analogy bookkeeping (572) — and NEITHER BUDGETS THE COST OF THE CHECK IT DEMANDS. Raised in both against/ files as a cross-item candidate and flagged for 14b under that name. Literature basis: Beyer et al. 2016 (attribute now, root-cause later); Chen et al. 2019, ICSE-SEIP (attribution is provisional and corrected by reassignment); Tariq et al. 2025, ACM CSUR 57(9) and Ancker et al. 2017, BMC MIDM 17:36 (the cost of over-triage is measured degradation of detection); Knuuttila & Loettgers 2014, The Monist 97(3) (a similarity gate would have blocked Ising -> Hopfield); Dunbar 1995 (analogy is the majority mode of productive reasoning); Chalmers, French & Hofstadter 1992, JETAI 4(3) (a pre-mapping representation gate is question-begging).
CROSS-ITEM SYNTHESIS 2026-07-29 (15c, over 15b's Mitigations sections in PRESUMPTION-573_against.md and PRESUMPTION-575_against.md — NOT a cross-item note 15b itself raised; corrected per 2026-07-29 verification DEFECT 1), over PRESUMPTION-573 + PRESUMPTION-575 (and cf. PRESUMPTION-565): UNOWNED, UNAUDITED SELF-CERTIFICATION. Self-issued instruments — a confidence grade, a coverage figure, an exclusion classification — are legitimate and indeed mandated practice across GRADE, APA, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53B, ISO/IEC 27005 and SSVC, but in EVERY one of those regimes they carry four attachments: (1) a rule or scale fixed in writing BEFOREHAND, independent of the item being graded; (2) a per-item recorded rationale rather than a bulk classification; (3) a named owner/approver DISTINCT FROM THE ISSUER; (4) a review date or resolution event at which the grade is scored or revisited. Strip those four and the instrument becomes what 15b calls "a self-issued grade with no examiner" — a token that discharges the obligation to verify without ever having measured anything. 15c disposition of this note: NOT raised as a fourth SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG. Its normative content is already validated as PREMISE-107 ("no self-produced artifact may certify itself ... denominators by independent corroboration"), PREMISE-103 (no confidence label over metadata-only material is well-founded; an explicit "unfounded pending retrieval" state is required) and PREMISE-124 (external baseline, seeded denominator, or an explicit UNCALIBRATED tag). Raising it as a new flag would mint a fourth overlapping instrument for a standard the register already holds — the register-inflation failure PREMISE-105 names. It is therefore FOLDED INTO DISPOSITION-555 and DISPOSITION-556, where the four attachments are recorded as the enforcement specification for premises already ACTIVE. Stated openly so the decision is reviewable rather than silent.

### 15a flags this run
15a raised NO NOVELTY flags this run. Two 15a disclosures are carried forward into dispositions rather than absorbed: (1) PRESUMPTION-572 carries a CORRELATION DISCLOSURE — its Gentner sources are the same primary sources underpinning PREMISE-127 and PREMISE-134, so the result is an APPLICATION of PREMISE-134 and NOT independent corroboration of it (see DISPOSITION-554); (2) PRESUMPTION-575's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 cl.6.1.3(d) citation was verified only via secondary description because the standard is paywalled (see DISPOSITION-556), which is reflexively ironic in that it is precisely PRESUMPTION-573's subject — a claim resting on a third-party description of a source that was not read — and, per the 15c note on the 15b return above, 15b did the same thing with the same clause in the opposite direction.

DISPOSITION-550:

  15a result: SUPPORTED | 15a strength: Strong
  15b result: CHALLENGED | 15b strength: Strong
  Net assessment: HANDLED AS A CONFLICT, NOT AVERAGED, per the explicit instruction and per Rule 7. The two directions cite the SAME standards document, NUREG/CR-5485, for opposite conclusions — 15a for "items sharing a design lineage are one common-cause component group, so instance separation earns no credit," 15b for "beta factors run 0.03-0.22, so 78-97% of failures remain independent and redundancy is credited with a discount." EXAMINED RATHER THAN SPLIT: these are not contradictory readings. They are two consecutive clauses of one method — first classify into a common-cause group (you may NOT assume independence), then quantify the dependence and credit the residual (you may NOT assume total dependence either). Read together they refute BOTH the presumption's binary reading AND the verification pass's unpriced credit. And both directions say so in their own summaries: 15a, "decorrelation ... is a measurable property of the joint error distribution ... it does not follow from any structural fact about how the checkers were instantiated"; 15b, "the whole point of the beta-factor and threats-and-safeguards frameworks is that the residual is SIZED; 'MONITOR-486 stands' names a residual without estimating it, and that gap — not the two-tier treatment — is the real defect." The strong-vs-strong conflict is therefore APPARENT at the level of the shared source and RESOLVED at the level of the finding.

PREMISE-120 already binds: "the phrase 'independently confirmed' is forbidden unless the second check obtained its own data by a different path. Every claimed second check must record what it shares with the first: code path, corpus, model, execution context." PREMISE-111 already SIZES the residual (a standing discount of the order of the 8-22pp panel shortfall, with the explicit rule that no downstream argument may cite 15a/15b agreement as independent confirmation). PREMISE-119 already prescribes the remedy: "price the defect; do not disown the output," with a retrospective impact assessment over results produced since last known-good. Minting a fourth instrument for a standard held three times over is precisely the register inflation PREMISE-105 names, so it is declined and said so. What the search establishes is therefore not a new premise but a LIVE VIOLATION: the 2026-07-28 verification pass called itself "a different instance than the one that wrote the citations, per PREMISE-132's decorrelation requirement" without recording what the two instances SHARE, which PREMISE-120 requires in terms, and without pricing the residual, which PREMISE-119 requires. That is a propagation failure of the kind PREMISE-116 and PREMISE-123 describe and REVISE-245 escalates — not a literature gap. Routed as a reinforcing MONITOR under the standing REVISE-245, with PREMISE-119's retrospective-assessment obligation named explicitly, and with 15b's three-arm measurement as the discharge condition (it converts MONITOR-486 from a flag into a number, which is exactly what REVISE-247 asks Tom to make possible).

Same-family miss rate close to the different-family arm's -> the model-level residual is small, the two-tier treatment was substantially correct, and MONITOR-486 gains its first number. DISPOSITION-551:
  Date: 2026-07-29
  Item: PRESUMPTION-568
  Item type: PRESUMPTION (unstated)
  15a result: SUPPORTED | 15a strength: Moderate to Strong
  15b result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED | 15b strength: Moderate
  Net assessment: 15a names the structure correctly and in external terms — an inflation of apparent convergence and an is/ought correction are UNDERCUTTING defeaters, which remove warrant from an inference without asserting its conclusion false, so "the disposition may still be right" does not establish "the stated ground survived." 15b does not deny this; it narrows where the defect lands. The sharpest source in either file is Hedges, Tipton & Johnson 2010: treating correlated estimates as independent corrupts the COVARIANCE and leaves the point estimate consistent — so an inflation of apparent convergence propagates reliably to the CONFIDENCE attached to a disposition rather than to its direction. Against that, 15b independently supplies two findings that cut back toward the presumption: ISA 450 names a pattern of individually immaterial defects all favouring one outcome as a qualitative BIAS INDICATOR, and the harmless-error search target failed to invert — the empirical literature shows harmless-error classification is systematically over-applied and that the same decision-maker who declares a defect harmless is measurably moved by it.
  Disposition: MONITOR (Medium-High)
  Reasoning: Held at MONITOR because the decisive test has not been run and is cheap: re-derive DISPOSITION-543 from the corrected grounds with the inflated-convergence ground DELETED rather than downgraded, and record whether INCORPORATE still follows and at what confidence. Both directions name that same test, so nothing further from the literature is needed — what is missing is an in-house computation, and per the spec it is better to MONITOR than to dispose ahead of it. Declined to INCORPORATE for a second reason worth stating: the one thing the evidence establishes without further work is that PREMISE-133's confidence was NOT revised after defect (2) was corrected, and a premise about confidence revision minted by the same agent whose confidence went unrevised would be self-serving in exactly the way this item is about. Declined to REVISE because nothing is broken by design and the remedy is in-house. NO NEW PREMISE PROPOSED — PREMISE-107 ("no self-produced artifact may certify itself") already governs the harmless-error half, which is why the monitor's condition is that the CLASSIFICATION, not the individual gradings, be reviewed by something other than the agent that produced the disposition.
  If MONITOR:
    What would change the disposition: (a) run the robustness test — re-derive DISPOSITION-543 from corrected grounds only; if INCORPORATE still follows, the presentational classification is vindicated on the literature's own terms and this closes; if it does not, convert to REVISE immediately. (b) Apply Walton's convergent/linked test to each remaining ground: if suspending any single ground destroys the support, the structure was LINKED, robustness does not apply, and the defect does propagate. (c) Apply the right-for-any-reason constraint: name the surviving ground and confirm it was in the record BEFORE the defect was found, not constructed afterwards. (d) Apply the ISA 450 aggregate test: tabulate all six defects by whether their correction raises or lowers support for the existing disposition — six of six favourable is the bias signature and warrants external review of the classification decision itself; a mixed distribution substantially defuses the item. (e) Check whether defect (5)'s normative premise appears anywhere in the pre-correction text; if it does not, it was supplied rather than surfaced and the correction is substantive. BINDING NOW under either reading, because both directions endorse it: treat defect (2) as a VARIANCE defect and restate PREMISE-133's confidence downward by whatever the inflated convergence was carrying, even if the disposition itself stands.

DISPOSITION-552:

  Item type: PRESUMPTION (unstated)
  15a result: SUPPORTED | 15a strength: Moderate to Strong
  15b result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED | 15b strength: Moderate
  Net assessment: BOTH DIRECTIONS INDEPENDENTLY REFUTE THE FRAMING THE PRESUMPTION SHARES WITH THE TEXT IT TARGETS. 15b: on counts this small a 1-to-5 movement sits inside ordinary Poisson variation, which is the whole reason funnel plots exist, and attributing a level change to an intervention from a single post-change observation is inadmissible under standard interrupted-time-series requirements. 15a reaches the same conclusion unprompted, in caveat (c), and says it is the simpler explanation than any mechanism in its own file. There is no anomaly to explain, so neither the note's causal reading nor the presumption's application-effect reading is licensed. Separately, the alternative the presumption leans on is the WEAKER hypothesis: the canonical Hawthorne result dissolved on reanalysis into a day-of-week artefact, the best systematic review finds effects small and wildly inconsistent, and the rival explanation — explicit topic-specific criteria immediately tighten judgement — has 75 studies behind it. What survives, and is challenged by nothing located, is the structural point: self-assessed effectiveness of a self-imposed bar, on the very run where the pipeline's competence to adopt premises about its own reliability was the item under judgement, is not independent evidence.
  Disposition: REVISE (route the correction back to 14b; retain the constructive half) — REVISE-250
  Reasoning: This is the batch's counterpart to DISPOSITION-544 and it is recorded for the same reason: an inference rested on a checkable numerical error, and the error is worth routing back because it is repeatable. Not MONITOR — nothing further is needed to settle the arithmetic. Not INCORPORATE — the presumption as written over-reads the number in order to under-read the explanation, and the surviving structural point is already held as PREMISE-124's FORBIDDEN MOVE ("reading a single favorable self-observation as evidence a safeguard 'works'"), so incorporating it would duplicate a premise the register has carried since 2026-07-24. The direction of the correction is stated so it cannot be misread: this does NOT vindicate the 2026-07-28 note. It finds that the note and the presumption made the SAME error in opposite directions, and that PREMISE-124 already forbade the note's move without needing any of this run's literature. APPLIED REFLEXIVELY, THIS RUN, RATHER THAN RECOMMENDED FOR LATER: this run's INCORPORATE count is 1 against last run's 5. That movement is reported as a count with its denominator (1 of 8 items dispositioned) and is NOT narrated as evidence about the bar, about this run's rigour, or about anything else. On the same Poisson reasoning that refutes 1-to-5, a 5-to-1 movement is equally uninformative, and claiming the drop as evidence of discipline would be the identical error with the sign flipped.
  If REVISE:
    What is at risk: a run-to-run count movement statistically indistinguishable from noise being filed as evidence that a self-imposed bar functions, on the run where the pipeline's own competence was the question — and that unearned validation then licensing further self-referential adoptions. Symmetrically at risk on the other side: a reflex of discounting any favourable post-change movement as reactivity, which would make the system unable to register that any of its own corrections ever worked.
    Recommended action: see REVISE-250 — (1) route the small-n correction to 14b; (2) stop describing 1-to-5 as a "fivefold rise" and plot the INCORPORATE count against its denominator with control limits before any explanation is offered; (3) run the discriminating test — apply the external-referent bar retrospectively and blind to the last 20 MONITOR dispositions and count how many now clear it, which converts a two-point comparison into a retrospective series with an unchanged decision context; (4) per Jonsson & Svingby, check the ADMITTED items for actual external-referent quality, since a criterion can raise consistency without raising validity.
    Urgency: Medium (no design change was made on this presumption; but it bears directly on how every future batch reports itself, and on this batch's own self-report)

  Net assessment: Both directions cite Boyd for opposite conclusions, and as with NUREG on 567 the two readings turn out to be compatible clauses of one doctrine: theory-constitutive metaphors do real referential work AND are open-ended, so the borrowing is legitimate AND its content is not yet fixed. 15a says exactly this in caveat (c). The directions therefore converge: hold the thalamic-transform claim at DISCOVERY / HEURISTIC grade, informing without warranting, and settle it by writing the template statement — does a PRS triplet support coordinate-like indexing, a composition rule, and a transformation that preserves something? — rather than by adjudicating the word. 15b's independent contribution is the demonstration that a domain-similarity GATE is the wrong instrument: the Ising template travelled magnetism -> spin glass -> Hopfield with no object-level similarity, analogy is the majority mode of reasoning in laboratories that produce results, and a pre-mapping representation gate is question-begging because the comparison is what produces the representations.
  Disposition: MONITOR (Medium-High), subordinate to PREMISE-134 — explicitly NOT a new premise
  Reasoning: 15a's own CORRELATION DISCLOSURE is decisive here and is carried rather than absorbed: its two load-bearing sources (Gentner 1983; Gentner, Rattermann & Forbus 1993) are the SAME primary sources underpinning PREMISE-127 and PREMISE-134, so this result is an APPLICATION of PREMISE-134 to a new instance and must NOT be counted as independent corroboration of it. Incorporating it would inflate the register and, worse, would manufacture the appearance of a second converging line of evidence for PREMISE-127/134 — the precise error the 2026-07-28 verification pass corrected in PREMISE-134's own entry, and the precise error PREMISE-111's standing discount forbids. PREMISE-122 additionally already governs cross-formalism equivalence claims (shared level of description, common system boundary, matching notion of control). So the item is routed as a MONITOR subordinate to PREMISE-134, whose boundary clause — the check gates CROSS ENTRY, not the comparison — already contains 15b's correction, which is a second reason not to mint anything. Holding this as graded bookkeeping rather than a gate is the in-run action on SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG (iii). The independent increment 15a DOES supply (Boyd; Daugman/Keller; Hawkins/Lindsay, on the REVERSE-direction case) is recorded in the monitor, together with 15a's PARTIAL NOVELTY signal — noted, not flagged, and treated accordingly: no general treatment was located of when a domain that borrowed vocabulary may import results back from the lender, and that reflexive/reverse formulation is where an original contribution might lie.
  If MONITOR:
    What would change the disposition: write the two representations side by side and attempt the TEMPLATE statement before any similarity judgement — specify what a cortical reference frame does formally (coordinate assignment, transformation under movement, composition of frames) and ask whether the PRS triplet supports each operation. All three map -> the shared term was tracking shared form, the terminological objection dissolves, and CROSS entry is warranted. One or two map -> record the residue as negative analogy and downgrade the claim from load-bearing to heuristic. None map -> the presumption is confirmed on structural grounds, which is a stronger result than confirming it on the grounds that the term was borrowed. SEPARATE AND NECESSARY: derive one prediction about PRS behaviour that follows from the frame reading and NOT from the triplet's ordinary properties. The falsifier currently on file is a prediction about thalamic activity, which tests Hawkins and is silent on C2A2; a transfer that generates no distinctive prediction is decorative regardless of how the vocabulary arose. DISPOSITION-555:
  Date: 2026-07-29
  Item: PRESUMPTION-573
  Item type: PRESUMPTION (unstated)
  15a result: SUPPORTED | 15a strength: Strong
  15b result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED | 15b strength: Moderate
  Net assessment: 15a's strongest point is structural and is not contested by anything 15b found: calibration is a property of MANY stated confidences scored against an external key, so a lone self-assigned tag is not a weak control but a non-measurement — there is nothing for it to be calibrated against. 15b does not dispute that; it disputes three narrower moves, and successfully. Same-process is not by itself disqualifying (verbalized confidence CAN be well calibrated and responsive to the generator's own uncertainty); the label does do control work (uncertainty expression measurably changes reliance and task performance); and "value cannot survive an unreadable source" is stricter than both APA's "as cited in" convention and GRADE's retain-with-a-grade design. But every challenging source carries the SAME condition rather than an absolution, and 15a's caveat (a) independently identifies the same boundary: the evidence undercuts the DISCHARGE reading of the label, not a ROUTING reading. Both directions therefore converge on four attachments without which a self-issued grade is, in 15b's phrase, "a self-issued grade with no examiner."
  Disposition: MONITOR (HIGH) — and NOT a new premise; recorded as live non-compliance with premises already ACTIVE. The 15b cross-item note on self-certification is folded in here.
  Reasoning: DUPLICATION CHECK RUN AND REPORTED, and it changed the disposition. PREMISE-103 already states, in terms, that "absence of primary text is a kind-difference in evidence, not a degree-difference: no confidence label over metadata-only material is well-founded, and downgrading confidence is not a valid substitute for an explicit 'unfounded pending retrieval' state" — which is PRESUMPTION-573's exact case, an item whose only evidence is a third-party description, carrying a downgraded confidence label. PREMISE-107 already states that no self-produced artifact may certify itself. PREMISE-124 already requires an external baseline, a seeded denominator, or an explicit UNCALIBRATED tag. A fourth premise here would be register inflation of the kind PREMISE-105 names, and it is declined. 14b itself derived the item FROM PREMISE-132's structure, which is a further indication of subordination rather than novelty. The finding is therefore a live violation of three ACTIVE premises, not a literature gap — the same shape as instances A and B of this cohort. The 15b cross-item note over 573 + 575 (+565) is recorded HERE rather than as a fourth SYSTEMIC-RISK-FLAG, for the same reason and stated openly: its normative content is PREMISE-107 + PREMISE-103 + PREMISE-124, and its genuinely new content is the four operating attachments, which belong as an enforcement specification for premises already held.
  If MONITOR:
    What would change the disposition: apply the four attachments, all of which are in-house and none of which requires a human arbiter. (1) A RULE FIXED IN WRITING BEFOREHAND — does a written confidence scale predate the labels, with criteria that do not depend on the item being labelled? A grep settles the factual half. (2) A PER-ITEM RECORDED RATIONALE rather than a bulk classification. (3) A NAMED OWNER/APPROVER DISTINCT FROM THE ISSUER — PREMISE-107 in its enforcement form. (4) A REVIEW DATE OR RESOLUTION EVENT: log a sample of Speculative items with a check-back date and score whether they later verified; without this no calibration claim is available in EITHER direction, which is the honest statement of the position. TWO FURTHER ADOPTABLE-NOW ITEMS, endorsed by both directions: adopt an explicit "as cited in" form so the citation carries the dependency rather than the confidence tag; and add a REACHABILITY field distinct from confidence, since "I judge this uncertain" and "I could not open the source" are different facts and collapsing them into one label is the actual defect — which is PREMISE-103's "unfounded pending retrieval" state arriving by an independent route. DECISIVE C2A2-SPECIFIC TEST (15b): sample 20-30 items carrying "Confidence: Speculative" and trace forward to see whether any downstream claim inherits one WITHOUT re-grading. If inheritance is found, the label is confirmed decorative in this system regardless of what the literature says about labels in general. Note on the specific conjunction at issue: the decisive test is not the label at all but whether any SECOND, INDEPENDENT description of the conjunction exists — a single third-party description is a single point of failure however it is graded.

DISPOSITION-556:
  Date: 2026-07-29
  Item: PRESUMPTION-575
  Item type: PRESUMPTION (unstated)
  15a result: SUPPORTED | 15a strength: Strong
  15b result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED | 15b strength: Moderate
  Net assessment: The item's GENERAL form is substantially refuted and its LOCAL form is conceded undefeated by the challenging direction itself. Refuted: a self-scoped denominator with documented, justified exclusions is not a workaround but the required output format of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST SP 800-53B; bounded scope is the explicit design of professional auditing under ISA 200/320, where absolute assurance is stated to be unachievable; and classification is not the absence of work, since "defer" is a terminal node of a decision tree in SSVC and retention is one of four named treatments in ISO/IEC 27005. Conceded: "the presumption's second clause — that today's finding was that the roster reader could not read the page — is a specific, local, and undefeated objection, and nothing located addresses it ... a figure derived from an unreadable page is being reported with the confidence of a figure derived from a read one." Both directions then land on the same requirement: not a maximal denominator, but a per-item recorded rationale, a named approver, a review date, and re-derivation by someone other than the classifier.
  Disposition: MONITOR (HIGH) — and NOT a new premise
  Reasoning: DUPLICATION CHECK RUN AND REPORTED. PREMISE-124 already states that a self-measurement of the pipeline's own completeness must cite an external baseline OR a seeded/independent denominator OR be reported as UNCALIBRATED, and already names capture-recapture and fault seeding by name in clause (a); PREMISE-107 already requires "denominators by independent corroboration"; PREMISE-109 already states that a summarizing agent is a view over its own read set and that a health claim not bound to a named artifact with a timestamp is not evidence of health. The surviving local finding is therefore a live violation of three ACTIVE premises, not a new one — the fourth instance of this batch's central pattern. The refuted general form is recorded so 14b does not repeat it: an absolute-denominator standard is held by no governance framework in use, and its practical effects are paralysis or perverse denominator inflation. TWO ADDITIONAL FINDINGS RECORDED RATHER THAN ABSORBED. First, 15a's own verification gap: its ISO/IEC 27001 cl.6.1.3(d) citation was verified only via secondary description because the standard is paywalled — reflexively, this is exactly PRESUMPTION-573's subject arriving inside the file that was supposed to settle a different question, and it is the second live instance of PREMISE-132 in two batches. Second, and not noted by either agent: 15b relied on the SAME paywalled clause, also unread, for the OPPOSITE conclusion. Two directions resting mutually opposed load-bearing readings on one unread source is a correlated verification gap, and under PREMISE-120 it must be recorded as such rather than counted as two readings.
  If MONITOR:
    What would change the disposition: have a second reader independently enumerate the roster and produce their own count WITHOUT SIGHT OF THE 21. Counts diverge -> the denominator is not merely self-set but wrong, and the presumption is vindicated on stronger grounds than it claims. Counts agree -> the enumeration survives its instrument's failure and the figure can be reported normally. CRITICAL INDEPENDENCE CONDITION (15a caveat (e), load-bearing): capture-recapture assumes independence between ascertainment routes, so two enumerations sharing the same broken reader would produce a FALSELY REASSURING overlap — the second route must not share the reader. Then audit the 11 excluded-plus-deferred items for per-item rationale, named approver and review date, and compute what fraction have all three; the governance-literature defence holds only for items that do. BINDING NOW: until re-derived, report "0 uncovered" as an UPPER BOUND with an explicit reachability caveat, since the instrument that produced the figure is known to have failed the same day — which is PREMISE-124's UNCALIBRATED tag applied to this figure. Calibration reference for the expected gap: self-reported 82% vs 68% on external audit of the same population (Kuperman et al. 2014), a ~14-point positive bias.
    Monitoring cadence: Weekly
    Priority: HIGH (a live reported completeness figure produced by an instrument known to have failed)
  PREMISE-133 COMPLIANCE: (a) discharge = the independent second enumeration plus the per-item rationale/approver/review-date audit; (b) adjudicator = requires a reader that does not share the failed instrument — in-house but NOT the roster reader; the "named approver distinct from the issuer" half is UNMET and inherits REVISE-247's gap; (c) deadline = 2026-08-12 (two weeks; a re-enumeration is cheap).

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-576
  Search direction: FOR (supportive)
  Result: SUPPORTED
  Strength: Strong
  Key source: Belkin, N.J., Oddy, R.N. & Brooks, H.M. 1982, "ASK for Information Retrieval: Part I," Journal of Documentation 38(2):61-71
  Summary: Information science has a fifty-year-old named theory whose central claim is the item's claim — the inquirer characteristically cannot specify what would resolve the anomaly that created the need, so systems must ELICIT rather than DEMAND that specification. Kraemer et al. 2006 (Archives of General Psychiatry) supplies the documented instance of the same circular gate surviving inside a heavily reviewed institution, with evidence that a pre-search guess offered to satisfy it actively misleads; the screening literature names the condition (cold start) and answers it by cheap seeding with revision, never exclusion (Ferdinands et al. 2023, Systematic Reviews); Boudreau et al. 2016 (Management Science) prices the false-negative side with randomised evidence that evaluation filters penalise novelty; and auditing standards (ISA 320/450, PCAOB AS 2810) show the accepted institutional answer is provisional-record-revise.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/for/PRESUMPTION-576_for.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-576
  Search direction: AGAINST (disconfirmatory)
  Result: CHALLENGED
  Strength: Strong
  Key source: ICH E9(R1) 2019, Addendum on Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis in Clinical Trials; with Wittes, J. & Brittain, E. 1990, Statistics in Medicine 9(1-2):65-71
  Specific risk: Over-reading the item removes the pipeline's only pre-commitment device; without a pre-specified target the settling quantity becomes whatever the search returned, no item can be recorded as having failed to settle, and the disposition record converts into a record of what the literature happened to contain (Chan et al. 2004, outcome reporting bias).
  Summary: The item equivocates on "quantity." A gate demanding a VALUE obtainable only from the search is circular; a gate demanding a SPECIFICATION of the quantity whose value the search supplies is ordinary pre-registration discipline — ICH E9(R1) requires the estimand a priori precisely because its value is unknown, PICO has required the outcome element pre-search since 1995, and value-of-information analysis ranks unrun searches from priors alone. Where the design parameter genuinely is a product of the data, internal-pilot methodology answers with a provisional commitment plus a licensed revision and a preserved error rate, not abolition of the gate. What survives is a narrower demand: require a nameable quantity TYPE with a provisional bound and one licensed post-search revision, sanctioned by deprioritisation rather than withholding.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/against/PRESUMPTION-576_against.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-577
  Search direction: FOR (supportive)
  Result: SUPPORTED
  Strength: Strong
  Key source: Fischhoff, B., Slovic, P. & Lichtenstein, S. 1978, "Fault Trees: Sensitivity of Estimated Failure Probabilities to Problem Representation," JEP:HPP 4(2):330-344
  Summary: Both halves of the item appear in one 1978 experiment — splitting a branch raises its perceived importance, and readers are insensitive to what a representation omits, so preserved sub-flag ids do not restore the weight that packing removes. Support theory supplies the mechanism (implicit subadditivity; Tversky & Koehler 1994) and partition priming establishes that the aggregator's partition choice is itself an input to the reader's judgment (Fox & Rottenstreich 2003, with a 2025 registered replication). Libby & Brown 2013 measures the nearest thing to the item's settling quantity in an audit setting: at matched magnitude, disaggregation lowers the threshold for requiring correction, and the effect shrinks when the detail is moved to a subordinate location — the published analogue of "the DISPOSITION ids are still there." CORRELATION DISCLOSURE filed by 15a: sources 1/2/4 partly elaborate PREMISE-121's own subject matter and are not independent corroboration of it.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/for/PRESUMPTION-577_for.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-577
  Search direction: AGAINST (disconfirmatory)
  Result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED
  Strength: Moderate
  Key source: PCAOB AS 2201 .62-.70; with Sloman, S.A., Rottenstreich, Y., Wisniewski, E., Hadjichristidis, C. & Fox, C.R. 2004, JEP:LMC 30(3):573-582
  Specific risk: Over-reading it forces peer-filing of related findings, so combined severity is never stated and the strongest flag is diluted by weaker neighbours — the failure mode AS 2201 was written to prevent. Under-reading it leaves the governance lever unmeasured: the count of independent findings against the presumption-construction layer becomes a quantity that layer controls on the run where the count is the datum.
  Summary: The item is right that consolidation is not salience-neutral and right that retrievability does not answer a salience question. What is challenged is the assumed DIRECTION: unpacking effects reverse with atypical components, dilution regresses a diagnostic item toward the mean when surrounded by less diagnostic ones (Nisbett, Zukier & Lemley 1981), and separately tracked items produce selective neglect of the structurally unusual one (Lipe & Salterio 2000). In the nearest professional analogue, combining related deficiencies is MANDATORY and isolated evaluation is the recognised error. What survives intact is the process defect rather than the substantive one — no symmetry check is recorded, and the aggregation was applied by the same pipeline to findings adverse to its sibling layer. The settling quantity is unmeasured in both directions.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/against/PRESUMPTION-577_against.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-586
  Search direction: FOR (supportive)
  Result: SUPPORTED
  Strength: Strong for the negative claim; Moderate for the specific reading of REVISE-251
  Key source: Koops, B.-J. 2021, "The concept of function creep," Law, Innovation and Technology 13(1):29-56
  Summary: The item's core — that a change in what a self-monitoring layer DOES cannot settle what it MAY do — is the settled position across four independent literatures. Koops defines function creep as a transformative change insufficiently acknowledged as requiring discussion, which is exactly the objection to an observation occupying the slot where an OPEN entry would have gone; Vaughan 1996 supplies the canonical case of a norm established by accumulated practice with no decision point; the IIA's 2024 Standards answer the checkable half institutionally (board-granted mandate, board-approved charter); Suber 1990 establishes that self-amendment is lawful procedurally and never by usage; McCubbins, Noll & Weingast 1987 makes drift the expected default of a delegated body and the remedy a procedure. 15a's own caveat (b), volunteered against its direction: the IIA and Suber sources show PROPOSING is legitimate and it is the missing APPROVAL that is condemned, so the item is best read as identifying a gap in the record rather than a usurpation.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/for/PRESUMPTION-586_for.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-586
  Search direction: AGAINST (disconfirmatory)
  Result: PARTIALLY-CHALLENGED
  Strength: Moderate
  Key source: International Law Commission 2018, Draft conclusions on identification of customary international law, UN Doc A/73/10; with IIA 2024 Global Internal Audit Standards
  Specific risk: Under-read, OPEN-138 closes by attrition — the practice element of authority is satisfied and the acceptance element is never recorded, which is the ILC's "mere usage" case and is expressly not a source of authority. Over-read, the item's argument form blocks any self-directed improvement, including improvements to independence, and throttles substantive work behind an authorisation queue (the RFC 7282 failure mode).
  Summary: The diagnosis is over-stated and the remedy is vindicated, and the literature separates them cleanly. The is/ought barrier is contested for institutional facts (Searle 1964), unavailable at the foundation where authority just is convergent official practice (Hart), and treated as the ordinary mode of norm formation by the ILC's two-element doctrine and by experimentalist governance (Sabel & Zeitlin 2008); RFC 7282 inverts the item's preference outright. The IIA dissolves the independence worry: the chief audit executive is supposed to own the risk assessment and plan, with board approval as the safeguard. What survives strengthened is the checkable half — the ILC requires opinio juris to be SEPARATELY ascertained from practice, the IIA requires a recorded approval, Sabel & Zeitlin require scheduled revision points, and all three name the same absent artefact at C2A2.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/against/PRESUMPTION-586_against.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-588 (narrowed: method for bounding the cost of a missing input)
  Search direction: FOR (supportive)
  Result: SUPPORTED
  Strength: Strong
  Key source: Molenberghs, G., Beunckens, C., Sotto, C. & Kenward, M.G. 2008, "Every missingness not at random model has a missingness at random counterpart with equal fit," JRSS-B 70(2):371-388
  Summary: Supported on the narrowed question, and the literature adds three things the item does not contain. First an impossibility result: the observed record cannot in principle distinguish a costly missing input from a costless one, so recording the cost as zero is an unidentified assumption presented as a finding. Second, the rate is not the bias — response rate is largely unpredictive of nonresponse bias across 59 studies (Groves & Peytcheva 2008), so seven consecutive dark syncs is not evidence of magnitude in either direction, which disciplines the item as much as it supports it. Third, three costed methods exist: the ghost-ads matched design (Johnson, Lewis & Nubbemeyer 2017), Howard's expected-value-of-clairvoyance upper bound (1966), and the E-value sensitivity bound (VanderWeele & Ding 2017); with Sculley et al. 2015 supplying the preventive measure — declare inbound context an explicit data dependency so its absence registers as an event rather than a silence. CORRELATION DISCLOSURE filed by 15a: sources 1/2 sit in the same selection/missingness family that plausibly underpins PREMISE-109.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/for/PRESUMPTION-588_for.md

RETURN-TO-14b:
  Original item: PRESUMPTION-588 (narrowed)
  Search direction: AGAINST (disconfirmatory)
  Result: CHALLENGED
  Strength: Strong
  Key source: Manski, C.F. 1990, "Nonparametric Bounds on Treatment Effects," American Economic Review 80(2):319-323
  Specific risk: Over-read, every uninstrumented channel becomes an unbounded cost — not conservatism but a systematic upward bias on the severity of anything not yet instrumented, self-amplifying in a pipeline that generates its own items. A specific version is over-crediting the missing input: sound work may be discounted or re-done on the basis of a quantity nobody bounded, and Liu et al. make it live that the missing context's contribution could have been neutral or mildly negative.
  Summary: On the narrowed question the challenge is largely dispositive: methods for bounding the cost of an input that never arrived are numerous and established, and none requires the matched comparison the item names. Worst-case bounds follow from the outcome's logical range with no assumption about the missingness mechanism; the E-value yields a falsifiable threshold computable from existing output; and the failure-detector literature (Chandra & Toueg 1996) shows undetectable omission is a property of uninstrumented RECEIVERS, not of omission. Two sources complicate the item's premises: the amount of missing input predicts distortion badly (Groves 2006), and added long-context input is not monotonically beneficial (Liu et al. 2024), so neither the magnitude nor the SIGN of the missing term is given. Molenberghs et al. then bound the item's own fix. What survives cleanly: nothing was instrumented, so the record does contain no bound. What falls: UNCALIBRATED is not the honest entry where a bound is cheaply computable.
  Full results: wiki/architecture/lit_search_results/against/PRESUMPTION-588_against.md

(8) THE STRONG/STRONG CONFLICTS ARE RESOLVED FROM THE SOURCE FILES, NOT AVERAGED — BUT ONE CONVERGENCE CLAIM IS INFLATED (DEFECT 1). On the primary question the answer is clear and favourable. DISPOSITION-560 does not split the difference: it names 15b's value/specification distinction as DECISIVE, lets the item's circularity claim FALL, and lets its constructive demand SURVIVE in a narrower form — an asymmetric resolution with a stated ground, which is the opposite of averaging. DISPOSITION-563 likewise refuses the midpoint: it accepts the item's OBSERVATION (nothing was instrumented, the record contains no bound) and REFUTES the item's OWN REMEDY from both directions, then substitutes three computable methods. Neither disposition says "both have a point." Both name what falls. Now the specific claim this pass was asked to test — that 15a conceded the point in its OWN caveats on 576, 586 and 588 BEFORE 15b was read. On 586 and 588 the claim is VERIFIED EXACT and is the strongest evidence in the batch. for/PRESUMPTION-586_for.md caveat (b), verbatim: "The IIA and Suber sources cut partly against the presumption's implicit alarm ... What the literature condemns is the missing approval, not the proposing. The presumption is therefore best read as identifying a gap in the record rather than a usurpation." That is precisely what DISPOSITION-562 attributes to it, volunteered against 15a's own direction, in 15a's own file. for/PRESUMPTION-588_for.md caveat (c), verbatim: "the two arms cannot be run simultaneously, so day-to-day variation in workload difficulty is fully confounded with the treatment at n=1 per arm. The ghost-ads design exists precisely because the naive two-arm comparison is untrustworthy." That is exactly the objection DISPOSITION-563 and REVISE-253 attribute to 15a, and it does arrive from the applied side rather than 15b's identification side, as claimed. On 576 the claim is INFLATED. DISPOSITION-560 says "15b's distinction is decisive and 15a concedes it in caveat (a) before 15b was read." What caveat (a) actually says, verbatim, is two things — and the first CONTRADICTS the attribution: "The support is for the presumption's *negative* claim (the rule as stated demands what the search supplies)." 15a affirms the very proposition 15b's distinction denies. What caveat (a) then concedes is adjacent and weaker: "Every source above is compatible with — and Ferdinands et al. positively recommends — requiring a *provisional* or *candidate* settling quantity at intake, which would satisfy most of REVISE-251's stated purpose at near-zero false-negative cost. If REVISE-251 is read charitably as already permitting provisional quantities, the presumption's force drops considerably." That is a concession about PROVISIONAL versus FINAL, not about VALUE versus SPECIFICATION. The two are cousins and they converge on the same AMENDMENT — so the disposition's operative claim, that both directions arrive independently at the same four-clause amendment, IS verified and is the sound part. But "15a concedes it" is not what happened, and the difference matters exactly as much as the 07-29 pass said it did: it converts an adjacent-and-weaker agreement into a same-point agreement, which is an inflation of apparent convergence in a run whose whole PREMISE-120 discipline is about not doing that. Recorded as DEFECT 1.
(9) DISPOSITION-562's REFUSAL TO MINT A PREMISE-114 SCOPE EXTENSION IS DEFENSIBLE, NOT AN EVASION — and the factual premise it rests on is confirmed. The refusal is then defensible on its own logic and, unusually, on the item's logic: PRESUMPTION-586's objection IS that a change in what a layer does cannot settle what it may do, and extending an unratified premise's scope by use would be an instance of the objection rather than an answer to it. Three things distinguish this from evasion. The run does not downgrade the finding to make the refusal comfortable — DISPOSITION-562 calls it "the batch's strongest INCORPORATE candidate" and says so before declining. DEFECTS FOUND (recorded, not silently fixed, per PREMISE-006; NO in-place corrections were made by this pass, and four of the five live in files this pass was instructed not to edit).
DEFECT 1, ATTRIBUTION / INFLATED CONVERGENCE, MEDIUM, and the only one that touches reasoning rather than form. DISPOSITION-560's "15b's distinction is decisive and 15a concedes it in caveat (a) before 15b was read" overstates what for/PRESUMPTION-576_for.md caveat (a) says. 15a concedes that a PROVISIONAL or CANDIDATE quantity at intake would satisfy most of REVISE-251's purpose at near-zero false-negative cost, and that under a charitable reading the presumption's force "drops considerably" — a real concession, volunteered against its own direction. It does NOT concede the value/specification distinction; the same caveat affirms that "the support is for the presumption's *negative* claim (the rule as stated demands what the search supplies)." The AMENDMENT convergence is genuine and verified and the disposition's outcome is unaffected; what is inflated is the DEGREE of pre-reading agreement, which is exactly the quantity PREMISE-120 exists to protect and the same class of error as 07-29 DEFECT 1 and PREMISE-133 defect (2). Fix: state it as "15a independently recommends a provisional-quantity intake, which the same amendment satisfies" and drop "concedes it." Note for contrast that the equivalent claims on 586 (caveat (b)) and 588 (caveat (c)) are verbatim-accurate, so this is a single slip, not a pattern.
DEFECT 2, PROVENANCE COMPLETENESS IN THE DISPOSITION REGISTER, LOW-MEDIUM. All five of DISPOSITION-560..564 carry PROVENANCE blocks with only FOUR of the six protocol fields — Origin, Chain, Transform at this step, Current status — omitting "Original item" and "Item type" from inside the block. No information is actually lost, because both appear as top-level fields of each disposition entry, so this is a form defect and not a traceability defect. It is also inherited drift rather than new (the 07-29 dispositions have the same shape). It is recorded because this run made a point of fixing the register-side provenance omission that the 07-29 pass raised and did not extend the same fix to its own disposition entries, so the batch is now internally inconsistent about what a PROVENANCE block contains.
DEFECT 3, ASYMMETRIC PROVENANCE CONFORMANCE WITHIN ONE BATCH, LOW. MONITOR-493 and MONITOR-494 carry full six-field PROVENANCE with a four-step Transform record (14b / 15a / 15b / 15c each named). REVISE-252 and REVISE-253 carry a single-line PROVENANCE with "Transform at this step=Net evaluation and disposition" — the 14b, 15a and 15b transforms are absent, and the protocol field is "Transform at each step," not "at this step." Four entries written by one agent in one run to two different standards. The fix is mechanical and the REVISE side should be brought up to the MONITOR side, not the reverse.
DEFECT 4, LABEL INCONSISTENCY, LOW / COSMETIC. REVISE-253's PROVENANCE line reads "Item type=PRESUMPTION (unstated) + SYSTEM RISK" where the entry's own header, DISPOSITION-564 and every other reference read "SYSTEMIC RISK." One word, no consequence, recorded only because an id-and-label register is the wrong place to let two spellings coexist.
DEFECT 5, SILENT CORRECTION OF AN INHERITED MISATTRIBUTION, LOW, and it is a PREMISE-006 defect rather than an accuracy defect. MONITOR-490 INSTANCE C (2026-07-29) attributes "no self-produced artifact may certify itself" to PREMISE-107; that is PREMISE-096's text. DISPOSITION-561 (2026-07-30) uses PREMISE-096 correctly. The 07-30 run therefore got it right while leaving the wrong version standing in the monitor register, unflagged — a divergence between two live records that a reader will hit and have to adjudicate. Flagging it costs one line. (The underlying misattribution is 07-29's, not this run's.)
ALSO RECORDED, NOT AS A DEFECT: REVISE-253's statement that "PREMISE-124 was relied on four times in the 2026-07-29 run and is relied on three times in this one" is NOT INDEPENDENTLY CHECKABLE AS WRITTEN. "Relied on" is undefined and raw mention counts are 53 in the 07-29 section and 13 in this one, so the figures must refer to load-bearing uses under some unstated rule. The claim may well be right; it cannot be verified from the record, and a countable claim in a register should carry its counting rule. This is the same species of point PREMISE-101 makes about counts being properties of a (scope, method, time) reading.

VERIFIER'S OVERALL ASSESSMENT. The batch is sound and its two hardest decisions are the right ones.   Net assessment: The two directions do not disagree about the world; they disagree about what follows. Both accept that an intermediate state CAN be given a computed entry criterion (partial identification supplies one), and both accept that whether it WILL be populated is unmeasured. 15b then supplies two things 15a does not: Dubois & Prade's objection that ignorance is a meta-evaluation rather than a third truth value, which makes the proposal a category error rather than a refinement; and the rating-scale measurements showing that three-category instruments perform WORST on reliability and discriminating power, with Krosnick's satisficing result naming the mechanism by which the new state gets filled with what the rater declined to adjudicate. 15a's own caveat (a) concedes the decisive empirical point before 15b was read — Cochran abandoned worst-case bounding because the bounds were too conservative to act on, and 15a records this against its own direction.

  Disposition: REVISE

  Reasoning: What tipped it is that the amendment under discussion (REVISE-253's amendment to PREMISE-124) RELAXES the one rule that currently blocks favourable self-produced numbers, and its stated validating test measures a quantity (frequency of dark days) that cannot confirm or refute its stated warrant (boundability). That mismatch is 14b's whole point and it survives both searches intact. This is not a MONITOR because there is a specific, cheap, decisive action available now and the item is blocking a pending recommendation rather than describing a live design: gate the amendment on a measured partition fraction with a threshold fixed BEFORE the measurement. Routed as an amendment to the pending REVISE-253 rather than as a new independent recommendation, so it narrows Tom's queue rather than lengthening it. NO PREMISE IS MINTED: on the evidence the third state's usefulness is exactly the open question.
